rows: **X1** Cronus = Saturn = Yaldabaoth
Hesiod: Cronus Titan, succeeds Uranus; Roman: Saturn outermost planet; Sethian: Yaldabaoth material ruler at Pleroma seam
Functional role: **limiting / material / outermost authority**
Limiting-authority function across all three
Fludd places Saturn at the top of the planetary hierarchy; Yaldabaoth is the bass of the material register. Pitch-order inverted if read as literal position.
No source assigns a specific pitch to any of the three
**X2** Zeus = Jupiter = Sabaoth
Hesiod: Zeus overthrows Cronus; Roman: Jupiter second-outermost; *Origin*: Sabaoth separates, ascends to seventh heaven, new authority
Functional role: **successor / reorganizing authority**
Succession-and-reorganization function across all three
Jupiter is *below* Saturn in planetary order, but Sabaoth is *above* Yaldabaoth in the Sethian ascent. The ordering is inverted between the Roman hierarchy and the Sethian ascent
No source assigns a specific pitch
**X3** Aether at 4/5 of Ogdoad
Hesiod: Aether child of Nyx/Erebus; Aristotle: fifth celestial element; no Valentinian source mentions Aether at a 4/5 boundary
Generative boundary: **new-element regime entering at 4/5**
Aether's structural position as a regime-boundary (Aristotle: distinct from four terrestrial elements)
Hesiod places Aether early (child of Night); Aristotle places it as fifth. Two different Aether coordinates. No Valentinian witness places Aether at 4/5
No primary Valentinian text connects Aether to Logos-Zoe or to any 4/5 transition
**X4** Mneme (2,3) ↔ Mnemosyne
Sethian: Mneme = third aeon of Oroiael; Hesiod: Mnemosyne = Titan, mother of Muses
Function: **memory as preserved distinction**
Memory-preservation function in both
Sethian Mneme is one aeon in a 4×3 structure; Hesiodic Mnemosyne is a Titan with nine offspring. Different genealogical roles, different downstream productions
No shared textual or historical witness connecting the two
**X5** Sophia (4,3) Sethian ↔ Sophia (30) Valentinian
Sethian: Sophia at (4,3) under Eleleth; Valentinian: Sophia 12/22/30 (witnessed)
Function: **terminal / seam-crossing**
Terminal position and class-boundary crossing in both
Different generative graphs: Sethian Sophia under Eleleth; Valentinian Sophia's deviation triggers Horos. Positional coincidence, not genealogical continuity
No cross-tradition generative link
**X6** Venus phases ↔ Decad
Astronomy: 5 synodic cycles ≈ 8 years, 5 morning + 5 evening; Valentinian: Decad of ten aeons
Venus has five morning and five evening manifestations; Decad has ten members

Fludd places Venus in the planetary scale at a specific proportional position. Kepler's Venus is near-unison (nearly circular orbit), which does *not* produce five distinguishable motion-based intervals. The 5+5 observational structure is not what Kepler's measured harmonies use
No source connects Venus's observational cycle to the Decad
**X7** Chinese $2/3\cdot4/3$ length ↔ SUN $2/3\cdot3/4$
Chinese: *sanfen sunyi*; SUN: kernel
Shared first operation $2/3$; divergent second
Exact mathematical preservation: Chinese gives $8/9$ length $=9/8$ frequency; SUN gives $1/2$ length $=2/1$ frequency. Both share the $2/3$ first operation exactly
None at the mathematical level. The systems are fully specified
No historical claim that SUN and Chinese theory derive from one source; X7 is a mathematical bridge only
Sefer: 22 letters; Marcosian: 24; proposed seam
Seam operator: **one boundary position separating class from generation**
The arithmetic holds exactly
No witness identifies a 23rd functional class. The Marcosian $9+8+7 \to 8+8+8$ correction preserves 24, not 23. The seam interpretation remains proposed
No witness
Marcosian I.14.5: 9+8+7=24, extension via Episemon to 30
Extension mechanism: **one additional distinguished symbol**
Arithmetic and report-consistency
The Episemon is one symbol yielding 30 from 24 (not from 22). This is a different mechanism from X8's seam
No identity with the 22/23/24 construction
**X10** Yaldabaoth at Pleroma 31
Valentinian: full Pleroma ends at 30; Sethian: Yaldabaoth is produced below the Pleroma
Position: **seam + 1**
Structural placement: one position after the completed Pleroma
No source places Yaldabaoth in the Valentinian Pleroma frame. The connection is SOL's cross-tradition commitment
No source-native succession
**X11** Sabaoth at fifth above
*Origin*: Sabaoth ascends to seventh heaven; Fludd: Jupiter one tone above Saturn; Kepler: Saturn-Jupiter not a fifth
Interval: **fifth (3:2)**
None as a historical interval. The structural relation (Sabaoth above Yaldabaoth) survives, but not as a specific fifth
Fludd places Saturn-Jupiter at a tone. Kepler does not single out the pair as a fifth. The fifth is not supported by either source
No historical source places Sabaoth a fifth above Yaldabaoth
Fludd: no fixed assignment giving F/C; Kepler: no fixed Saturn-Jupiter fifth; SOL: working pitch commitment
Interval: **fifth (3:2)**
The interval $F:C = 3:2$ is a mathematically valid perfect fifth
Neither Fludd nor Kepler places Saturn at F or Jupiter at C
No historical confirmation of the specific pitch assignment
